\section[(dialogue)]{The body, family, doing and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R77-first-pass-the-body-family-doing-and-food}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item skin, a nail, the chin, the throat, a cheek
  \item the chest, the stomach, an ankle, an elbow, a wrist
  \item pain, a fever, a cough, a medicine, a doctor
  \item a hospital, an illness, thirst, tiredness, ill
  \item joy, fear, anger, sadness, happy
  \item sad, pleased, a daughter; a girl, a grandfather, a grandmother

  \item to cry, to wash, to cook, to play, to learn
  \item to teach, to drink, to eat, to give, to live
  \item to come back, to study, to pay, to use, to show

To laugh? (\textbf{rire}.) To cry? (\textbf{pleurer}.) To wash? (\textbf{laver}.) To cook? (\textbf{cuisiner}.) To play? (\textbf{jouer}.) To learn? (\textbf{apprendre}.) To teach?
